source_pr_title: fix(gha-runner): seed the store with tar pipes instead of cp -a
author: cubic-dev-ai
body:
<!-- cubic:v=63f08775-6e24-407d-8998-69506a768d4c -->

P2: On a reused PVC whose prior seed ran under a different SCC UID, the tree is owned by that prior UID. chmod only changes permissions on files you own, and the runner is non-root (`runAsNonRoot: true`), so `chmod -R u+rwX /nix-pvc` cannot open up a stale tree owned by another UID, and the comment's goal of letting tar unlink stale read-only dirs is not met. The mount uses fsGroup (`fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch`), so files are group-owned by the fsGroup the pod is a member of — use `g+rwX`, consistent with the rest of this script and the fsGroup-based cross-UID compatibility model. The same applies to the subsequent `rm -rf /nix-pvc/var/nix/profiles`, which set -e will abort if the dir can't be removed for lack of group write.

+  # read-only and tar must be able to unlink their contents.

+    chmod -R u+rwX /nix-pvc
+  fi
